description: Conformance vectors for the SRL transformation receipts and adapter semantic profiles (WP-B12): two TransformationReceipt conversion classes (LOSSLESS unit-annotate, LOSSY_EXPLICIT backend projection), an AdapterSemanticProfile for a solver backend that lacks calculus1, and the three prohibited collapses the honesty rules prevent (a lossy step claiming LOSSLESS, an unsupported op hitting behavior=reject, a profile claiming an op outside the MathIR allowlist). Each positive vector is a valid object that must validate against its schema (and pass the Python validator); each negative vector names the validator, exception, and fail reason its input must be rejected with.

positive.name: p01-receipt-lossless
positive.description: A LOSSLESS TransformationReceipt binding a Newton's-second-law MathIR object to itself under a normalize step (no introduced assumptions, no dropped features). source_object_id == target_object_id because a lossless step yields a byte-equal tree.

positive.name: p02-profile-solver-no-calculus
positive.description: An AdapterSemanticProfile for a deterministic, offline, Apache-2.0 solver backend that supports arith1.plus/minus/times and relation1.eq and declares behavior=drop for calculus1.diff (no symbolic differentiation). supported_cds is a subset of MATH_IR_ALLOWLIST.

positive.name: p03-receipt-lossy-projection
positive.description: A LOSSY_EXPLICIT TransformationReceipt produced by projecting calculus1.diff(x) onto the p02 solver profile (which drops calculus1.diff). The receipt binds the adapter_profile_ref (the p02 profile_id) and the pack_hash (the p02 pack_ref digest), drops calculus1.diff, and introduces the matching assumption. The lineage link is honest: a lossy step never upgrades evidence.

negative.name: n01-lossless-claims-dropped
negative.reason: A receipt claiming conversion_class=LOSSLESS while dropping calculus1.diff violates the lossless_requires_no_loss invariant. Rejected by the schema allOf/if-then and by srl.semantic.transforms.validate in Python (defense in depth) with CONTRACT_INVALID.

negative.name: n02-projection-reject
negative.reason: Projecting a tree carrying calculus1.diff onto a profile that declares behavior=reject for calculus1.diff halts the projection with UnsupportedFeatureError (fail reason IR_UNSUPPORTED). The op and its cd are named on the error.

negative.name: n03-profile-op-outside-allowlist
negative.reason: A profile claiming support for transc1.exp (outside MATH_IR_ALLOWLIST) violates the supported_op_outside_allowlist invariant: the allowlist is closed, a profile may only claim support for operators the IR admits. Rejected by validate_profile with CONTRACT_INVALID.
